While on patrolling duty on 8/7/2023, the complainant  received confidential information that a tempo wa

The vehicle was stopped near H.A.L.
township gate no.3, at 2.30 p.m.
It was found that the vehicle was carrying 30 gunny bags containing 570 packets of Pan Masala and scented tobacco in each bag.
It was later revealed that the said goods were transported from Indore.
The applicant is from Indore.
During the course of the raid in the godown, the applicant was found, from where he was arrested.
4. It is the prosecution case that the applicant is the manager of the main accused who owns the godown and these products.
Learned APP opposed the application and submitted that huge quantity of banned product was found.
5. The issue whether the contraband would be covered by Section 328 of the IPC is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
The applicant was arrested on 13/7/2023 and now is in custody for almost three months with no possibility of the trial concluding any time soon.
The investigation is complete.
The charge-sheet has been filed.
There are no criminal antecedents reported against the applicant.
The applicant does not appear to be a flight risk.
